crossRefs.note: “ ‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil…

parallels.note: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley…

translations.web: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.
translations.bsb: And you are to put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
translations.asv: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meal-offering.
